verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS CRM, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has nothing on telemetry, analytics opt-out or usage-tracking controls; it covers integrations, webhooks, APIs and pricing only. Kommo-docs-22's 'Track ROI' refers to sales analytics, not user telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
